No qualifying plays — and the best of what remained

Today's ✳ Best of Board is Pittsburgh Pirates ML (-120, BetOnline.ag) (New York Mets @ Pittsburgh Pirates) at 0 units: the model's top remaining choice, published with every gate it failed. We show it so you can see the reasoning; we don't stake it, and it never enters the ledger.

Three angles a bettor would actually check

  • The mound mismatch: New York Mets @ Pittsburgh Pirates. Robert Stock (1.80 ERA) against Bubba Chandler (4.49) is a 2.7-run ERA gap. The engine stabilizes both with FIP and innings before believing it — a raw ERA gap this wide usually shrinks under the hood, and the market has already priced most of what survives.
  • The total: Cleveland Guardians @ Chicago White Sox. The sim lands on 8.9 runs against a 7.5 line — 1.4 toward the over. Totals remain in their paper proving period on the watch list: computed, published, graded at 0 units until the record earns promotion.
  • The cold bats: Athletics @ Boston Red Sox. Rule 6 fired — the road offense's trailing-14-day wOBA sits far enough under league that the engine taxes its scoring 8%, a size set by a full-season backtest, printed on the card.
